content.short: DeGuard is a decentralized VPN and security platform that provides users with privacy-focused internet access and digital asset protection.
content.description: DeGuard is a Web3-native security solution that offers decentralized VPN services to ensure private and uncensored internet access for its global user base. By utilizing blockchain technology to manage access and encryption, DeGuard removes central points of failure and enhances user privacy. Built with the Mantle Network in mind, DeGuard allows users to secure their online activity and manage their security preferences using a decentralized and verifiable infrastructure.
content.meta: DeGuard is a decentralized VPN and security platform for private internet access on Mantle. Discover DeGuard on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
